jobs.title: Product Manager II - LO\S
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.


Role Summary
As an Associate Product Manager, you will play a hands-on role in shaping the feature-level execution of our AI tools and platform initiatives. Working closely with Senior PMs, Engineering, UX Design, and Customer Success, you will turn legal workflows, real-time AI transcription, and automated matter intelligence into practical, user-friendly product features.
 

Responsibilities:
-
Feature Execution & Requirements: Write clear, actionable user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria to bring AI-driven feature enhancements to life.

-
LOIS & Depositions Focus: Help execute functional requirements for LOIS-powered capabilities (such as automated deposition summaries, goal tracking, real-time AI analysis, and context-driven workflows).

-
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner day-to-day with engineering and UX designers to transform customer needs into intuitive, well-designed software solutions.

-
Backlog Grooming & Slicing: Work iteratively with dev teams using Agile practices—slicing user stories into incremental deliverables, helping anticipate bottlenecks, and maintaining an organized sprint backlog.

-
Customer Research & Insights: Participate in customer calls, review feedback, and analyze product usage metrics to identify user pain points and inform feature-level decisions.

-
Quality & Acceptance Testing: Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) alongside QA and engineers to ensure features meet quality standards before reaching customers.

-
Go-To-Market & Enablement Support: Collaborate with Product Marketing and Customer Success to help build release notes, internal feature documentation, user guides, and training materials.

-
Product Advocacy: Act as an internal subject matter expert for your assigned feature set, keeping internal teams updated on upcoming releases and functional changes.
Qualifications:
-
Experience: 3–5 years of experience in software product management, APM roles, or closely related positions (e.g., Business Analyst, Product Owner, Implementation Specialist) in SaaS.

-
Education: B.S. or M.S. in business, computer science, information systems, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

-
Domain Interest: Interest in legal tech, generative AI, or complex workflow automation (prior experience in Legal Tech, Depositions, or AI products is a bonus, but not required).

-
Agile/SDLC Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of Agile/Scrum software development lifecycles and modern backlog management tools (e.g., Jira).

-
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Comfort working with user feedback and basic quantitative data to prioritize work and solve complex logic problems.

-
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on translating business needs into clear technical documentation.

-
Travel: Ability to travel periodically for team alignment at Salt Lake City HQ, customer visits, or legal tech conferences.
Compensation Information: $110,000 - 150,000 
 
The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity - the range listed is just one component of Filevine’s total compensation package for employees. This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.


Work Location Expectation: Remote or option to be hybrid/in-office in one the following locations: San Francisco, New York, Chicago, or Salt Lake City
 
 
Cool Company Benefits:
- A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive 
- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
- Competitive & Fair Pay
- Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
- Short & long-term disability
- Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
- Top-of-the-line company swag

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.


Role Summary:
As a Product Marketing Manager, you will be a key part of the execution engine behind Filevine's go-to-market motions. You will take our sophisticated Legal Operating Intelligence System capabilities and turn them into highly effective customer-facing assets, product content, and targeted tier-1 through 3 launches.
Working directly at the intersection of Product Management, Sales, and Marketing, you are responsible for keeping pace with an AI-forward environment where speed wins. This role requires a highly technical, execution-oriented marketer who thrives under tight timelines and loves getting their hands dirty building collateral, analyzing competitors, and helping cross-functional teams move forward together.
What You'll Do:

Product Content & Technical Literacy
- Messaging and Positioning: You will own messaging and positioning of the individual products within the portfolio for business partners and stakeholders.

- Collateral Engine: Author high-impact, foundational product content, customer presentations, pitch decks, feature blogs, and clear value-proposition briefs.

- Technical Literacy Translation: Take complex, technical AI architectures and LLM capabilities and translate them into intuitive, emotionally resonant customer facing collateral.

- Flawless Execution: Maintain high-quality craftsmanship while building assets rapidly to match the velocity of our product engineering cycle.
Launch Execution & GTM Orchestration
- Cross-Functional Delivery: Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure everyone contributes effectively to GTM strategies and hits their respective milestones.

- Use Case Activation: Deeply understand buyer behaviors to develop and activate Filevine’s core use-case messaging, ensuring our positioning resonates from solo practitioners to enterprise legal teams. Understanding various types of legal practices is a must, direct legal industry experience is a strong plus!
Sales Enablement & Battlecard Culture
- Battlecard Architecture: Conduct ongoing competitive research to build, update, and deploy actionable battlecards and win/loss insights to keep Sales ahead of legacy tech and AI point solutions.

- Revenue Enablement Support: Support the implementation of comprehensive training programs to ensure Sales, Product Management, and Partner teams can effectively position Filevine’s unique advantages.

- Market and analyst relations/awareness : Track competitive and analyst environment to support briefings and reports that help to shape how Filevine is seen/understood by the market

- Win/loss discipline: Own a consistent win/loss practice and turn the findings into positioning changes.
Preferred Technical Acumen
- Generative AI & LLMs: Comfort with technical concepts, APIs, modern software architectures, and specific familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or legal workflows.

- Technical Translation: Ability to translate complex technical concepts and SaaS architecture into clear, compelling customer-facing materials and value propositions.

- Cross-Functional Tech Alignment: Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management and Engineering teams to translate product roadmaps into GTM strategies.
Qualifications:
- Professional Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated product marketing experience within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally experiencing the high-growth transition from Series C to IPO. Previous experience as a legal professional is a strong plus.

- AI-Forward Execution & Velocity: Proven experience working in a fast-paced technology or AI environment. You understand that speed wins, and you have a track record of flawlessly executing GTM tasks under tight timelines.

- Proactive Writer & Practitioner: A stellar portfolio demonstrating your ability to write clear, compelling product content and high-stakes customer-facing presentations.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated success partnering across product, sales, and marketing teams to execute unified strategies.

- Analytical & Technical Curiosity: Comfort with technical concepts, APIs, and modern software architectures. Specific familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or legal workflows is highly advantageous.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Technical Writing, or a related field. A JD is also accepted and encouraged.

The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity - the range listed is just one component of Filevine’s total compensation package for employees. This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.


Work Location Expectation: Filevine maintains offices in Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Chicago, and New York. Candidates based in or near these metropolitan areas will work on a hybrid or in-office schedule, while candidates located outside these regions are eligible for remote work

Role Summary: 
 
As a Sr. Product Manager at Filevine, you'll be a critical force in shaping the future of our legal technology platforms. You'll take ownership of new product initiatives, from conception to market launch, with a focus on exceeding customer expectations and driving business growth.
 
You’ll work on products in the Depositions by Filevine platform, an AI-powered legal-tech solution that revolutionizes how law firms and legal teams manage depositions. From automated scheduling and seamless hosting to real-time AI analysis, goal tracking, and post-deposition synthesis, a product transforming a traditionally manual process into an integrated, data-driven system

Responsibiliites
- Delivering the product vision : Develop comprehensive product plans, specifications, and user stories that bring high-quality features and enhancements to life.

- Roadmap Execution : Work collaboratively with product leadership and teams to continually execute against the product roadmap.

- Championing the user experience : Own the product's UX and feature set development, ensuring a seamless and delightful experience for every user.

- Building strong partnerships : Collaborate closely with engineering teams to craft usable user experiences and deliver effective solutions. You'll be the voice of the customer in the development process, ensuring features are built to solve real-world problems.

- Bridging the gap: Translate complex customer and business needs into clear, actionable specifications, business rules, flows, and use cases.

- Customer Adoption: Actively hop on customer calls to understand their needs and pain points firsthand to inform product decisions and improve their experience.

- Data-driven decision-making : Analyze data and customer feedback to identify problems, measure results, and prioritize opportunities.

- Agile work style : Slice user stories into manageable chunks, define acceptance criteria, and work iteratively with engineers

- Prioritization master: Anticipate bottlenecks, collaborate with teams to optimize the backlog, and ensure projects align with business needs and long-term goals.

- Quality assurance champion : Help with product acceptance testing, working with QA, engineers, and customers.

- Launch leader: Drive zero-to-one product launches and contribute to go-to-market. Partner with the GTM team to build value propositions, marketing videos, email copy, and one-pagers that capture the essence of your product and resonate with target audiences.

- Evangelizing your product: Proactively educate everyone within the organization about your product area, creating excitement, and buy-in. Ensure everyone is equipped to advocate for your creations.

- 5+ years of software product or project management experience in SaaS environments; experience in Legal, Legal Tech, or AI strongly preferred.

- 2+ years of experience delivering software solutions for the legal industry, ideally related to depositions (preferred).

- Deep knowledge of software development methodologies and hands-on experience working within the full software development life cycle.

- Proven ability to solve complex problems creatively, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and maintain a strong focus on business success.

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities with a consistently data-driven approach; experienced in Agile/Lean delivery frameworks.

- Passionate about driving efficiency, quality metrics, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - LO\S
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Job Summary
Filevine is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead cross-functional delivery of LOIS, our Legal Operating Intelligence System. In this role, you will own the end-to-end coordination of a large, geographically distributed program spanning engineering, product, design, machine learning, data science, and operations and ensure that complex, multi-team initiatives move from concept to customer with clarity and momentum. This is a foundational role with significant organizational impact, establishing and maintaining the program infrastructure, processes, and visibility mechanisms that allow a large and growing team to execute with speed and confidence.
Responsibilities
-
Own the master program plan for LOIS feature development, maintaining a transparent, grounded, continuously updated view of timelines, milestones, and cross-team dependencies that will be used across the organization

-
Proactively identify, track, and resolve blockers and dependency risks across engineering, product, design, ML research, data science, SRE, and operations, working independently and in concert with senior product and engineering leadership

-
Establish and evolve lightweight coordination and delivery infrastructure, including rituals, tooling conventions in Linear, and communication norms, that cultivate strong cross-team alignment

-
Serve as the key connection between the core LOIS development teams and supporting stakeholder functions (QA, operations, etc.), ensuring timely engagement to enable smooth, rapid feature delivery

-
Absorb and manage the impact of unexpected changes, delays, and discoveries during development by updating forecasts, communicating tradeoffs, maintaining coordination without losing delivery momentum

-
Partner closely with product and engineering leadership on release planning, ensuring that program structure reflects and supports strategic priorities

-
Build and maintain a culture of transparency and accountability across the program, ensuring that status is honest, risks are surfaced early, and teams have what they need to do their best work
Qualifications
-
7+ years of technical program management or equivalent experience delivering complex software across multiple geographically distributed teams in different disciplines

-
Demonstrated ability to hold a large, multi-workstream program together under ambiguity: crafting plans, maintaining them under pressure, and communicating status credibly to both technical and executive audiences

-
Deep familiarity with software engineering practice at a working level. Strong candidates should be comfortable in conversations about system architecture, APIs, infrastructure, and technical tradeoffs

-
Proven track record of building coordination processes and infrastructure in environments where they did not previously exist, showing good judgment about deploying formal vs lightweight methods

-
Strong experience with modern project and issue-tracking tooling (Linear, Jira, or equivalent), and critically the use of these tools to make dependencies and progress visible across a large base of contributors and stakeholders

-
Experience working on products that incorporate ML or LLM-based components is a meaningful plus, particularly where model behavior, data pipelines, and research cycles intersected with product delivery timelines

-
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to earn trust and influence outcomes across engineering, product, research, and operations without formal authority over any of them
